searchText: Would it be possible to develop a ERC-20 token that "resets" after a while? What would happen if a ERC-20 token cleared out all ownership and changed some parameters (like its name) without "changing" its address? I assume the usual tools don't rely on ERC-20 token balances and other properties staying constant, but that they check the properties on the block-chain when needed? (short-term caching aside!) You'll get a better answer at https://discord.gg/hSxj4w7a most likely. Short answer though is that you'll probably break a whole lot of stuff (like Uniswap). <@!301186049323958275> Thanks for the pointer! I'll take up the conversation there. That's actually why I joined this discord server. That one seems more pertinent!
